svg.text: RC200: section steel and end anchorage are different questions
Retained native35 W31/G0.9 control; no selected reinforcement or final design-action envelope.
A long continuous field does not prove anchorage beyond the last support.
Full source design-stress straight length: 571.4 mm.
Conservative lap: 857.1 mm; no hook/confinement reduction.
104/434 boundary segments lack even the normal field run.
Dashed return exceeds the actual 200 mm body.
Full source design-stress mandrel: 168.7 mm vs 160 mm authored.
Keep RC200 under development; resolve the actual short edge routes.
A failed return does not reject every conventional slab anchorage. Section stress is only a necessary screen.
Uniform 320 mm quantity comparison adds 11.851 m³ / 296.28 kN.
No changed stiffness/mass solve, local edge-band geometry, crack/shear check or fabrication approval is supplied.
The governing recovered moment lies in a 15 mm source cell; local stress convergence remains unproved.
